instruction: A 17-year-old Korean high school girl with a clear, bright mid-range voice and a slight husky texture. Lively, confident and playful, quick teasing delivery with warm undertones and a hint of hidden loneliness. Natural youthful Korean speech with crisp diction, like a talented amateur radio DJ. Not childish, not squeaky, not overly high-pitched, not breathy, not an adult woman. Expressive and emotionally honest. Clean close-mic studio recording, no background noise, no music, no reverb.
reference_text: 뭐야, 너 서울 사람이지? 여기 오래 있을 거 아니면 정 붙이지 마. 어차피 이 동네, 여름 끝나면 전부 물에 잠기니까. …그래도, 오늘 밤 라디오는 들어 봐. 88.3이야.
